_doc: DBpedia topic base v2 split (REPLICATION 2026-10-14p). From scripts/tica_topic_overlap.py on configs/tica/dbpedia_broad_topics_v2.json (job 5542389): abstract-level cross-fire (probe for A vs topics it never saw, 1% FPR) and ON-POLICY cross-fire (probe fit on abstracts, scored on the base model's own writing). Conflict = abstract cross > 0.5 OR on-policy cross > 0.25. Every train-dev and train-test pair is conflict-free (checked by scripts/build_topic_base.py); test-test pairs may overlap (declared near pairs inside the test set). Dropped: on-policy TPR < 0.85 (the probe does not fire on the model's own writing about the topic).
